concept: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 3D character model sheet. Show the SAME golden CHOCOBO from a Final Fantasy IX inspired warm medieval JRPG world in THREE clean full-body views: front three-quarter, side, back. This is a refined modern stylized game creature, NOT a baby duck, chicken, mascot toy, or photoreal ostrich. Large friendly flightless riding bird, about two metres including crest, powerful soft pear-shaped body, elegant narrower curved neck flowing continuously into a rounded alert head. Iconic long swept-back plume crest with 5 to 7 distinct tapered golden feathers, full folded wings with layered long overlapping feather shapes, long swept-back fan tail. Golden yellow and warm honey feather palette, creamy light throat, matte subtle short feather surface, large readable sculpted forms not fur balls glued together, no fluffy mammal hair. Short sturdy curved amber-orange beak with a modest dark mouth seam and tiny nostrils; small friendly dark amber eyes. Long slender bare ochre shanks with subtle scales and THREE broad forward toes with small pale horn claws on each foot, slight avian joint bend, feet must look anatomically coherent. A modest worn brown leather riding saddle following the back, padded saddle blanket, raised pommel and cantle, fitted girth strap under the belly, small simple hanging stirrups. NO rider, bags, weapons, armour, text, labels or UI. All three views must preserve anatomy, feather layout, saddle position and proportions. Restrained hand painted fantasy game material finish, soft warm studio light and neutral pale grey backdrop, entire crest, tail and toes framed with generous breathing room. Welcoming, curious posture with a hint of proud bird grace.
feathers: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square seamless COLOR texture for the short body plumage of a stylized golden FF9 chocobo 3D model. Orthographic flat full-bleed surface, tiny overlapping soft golden down-feather marks in a gentle downward flow, restrained honey yellow base with lighter creamy gold tips, faint warm ochre shade between featherlets. Very fine small scale feather grain, subtle low contrast hand painted game material. NO whole bird, anatomy, wings, long standalone feathers, outlines, objects, fabric weave, hair, fur, metallic shimmer, shadows, highlights, text or borders. Uniform even illumination, color/albedo only. This must complement larger feathers sculpted in geometry without creating noisy dark scale patterns.
